All descendants of excluded elements are dropped

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".sidebar\"]}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<body><aside class=\"sidebar\"><h2>Related</h2><p>Sidebar text</p></aside><main><p>Main text</p></main></body>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
